_readme: Example configuration for the pi-jev-mgt extension (jev-router).
or point $PI_JEV_ROUTER_CONFIG at it. The file is re-read on change.
Slugs and prices change often: run /jev-recommend to rank the 3 most
suitable models from the live OpenRouter catalog, or /jev-models to browse
Prices below are only illustrative. `models` is a preference list WITH
fallback on OpenRouter's side; `excludedModels` is a HARD restriction and is
`language` sets the language of the extension UI: "auto" (default, follows
Pi's settings, then $PI_LANG, then the system locale), or one of en, fr, es,
it, de. It can also be changed from /jev-models -> Language.
This one file drives both routing paths:
pi --model jev/auto              -> Pi routes locally as a virtual model
Per-entry `tier` (flash/balanced/power) is operative on the jev/auto path:
the router prefers an entry whose tier matches the requested band, in list
order. With jev/auto, the selected thinking level picks the band: low ->
flash, medium -> balanced, high/xhigh/max -> power. costTier caps both.

allowedModels.note: cheap, 1M ctx, vision - verify price with /jev-recommend
